```{=html}
<div class="td-top">

  <p class="td-note">The Tune Assessment's finder, over the tunes and the classical themes. <b>Functions</b> (ii V I) finds pieces with all
  of those chords in any order; <b>Progression</b> (ii V I) only those with the chords one after another in that order. Both read Roman
  numerals over the tonic, and also search the Billboard songs. <b>Tonal pattern</b> takes syllables (Do Me So) or scale degrees
  (1 b3 5; 1 is Do, b3 is Me, #4 is Fi). A filter the Billboard songs or analysed scores have nothing to answer with leaves them out.</p>
  <div id="td-music-status" class="td-note"></div>
  <div id="td-picker"></div>
</details>
<div id="td-status">Loading the collections…</div>
```

## Pieces with recordings and resources {#td-works}

```{=html}
<p class="td-note"><span id="td-works-n"></span>. A piece groups every place it appears on the site (a tune in several keys, a
classical theme, an analysed score) and holds its recordings and links. They are kept in <code>apps/shared/works/works-data.js</code>.</p>
<div id="td-works-list"></div>
```

```{=html}
<p class="td-note"><span id="td-tunes-n"></span>. A title opens the tune in the <a href="tunes.html">Tune Library</a>; 🎧 jumps to its piece above.</p>
```


## Billboard songs (chords and form) {#td-billboard}

```{=html}
<p class="td-note"><span id="td-bb-n"></span> from the McGill Billboard Project (1958–1991): each song's sections, bars and chords,
timed. A title opens it in <a href="../tools/timestamp-notes.html">Timestamp Notes</a>; no recording comes with it, so find the song on
YouTube and paste the link there.</p>
<div id="td-billboard-list"></div>
```
